description: Prove your profile owns an ERC-8004 agent identity on Base: the registry token's owner or agent wallet must be your verified wallet. Read-only on chain; nothing is sent. Pass agent_id null to unlink.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.
